I cup my mouth and take in the water, then I spat into the sink. I watched the red stains swirl around and disappear down the drain. My mouth was throbbing and my vision wasn't doing so well either. I stared into the mirror. I was a mess. A swollen eye and a tooth knocked out. The bandage on my cheek was starting to bleed through again so I opened the medical cabinet behind the mirror. I scanned the shelves and pulled out the box of bandages. I pulled off the bloody piece and checked my wound on the mirror. It was a minor gash, but I don't want it to get infected so I rubbed some alcohol on it. It hurt a bit, but I managed. I applied a fresh bandage on the wound and put the box back into the cabinet. I knocked a pill bottle off the shelf and it landed into the sink. I sighed. I picked it up and then I realized it was the medicine that came today. I should read the label.

New Day Pills

Start the day renewed!

Directions: Take one before going to sleep. Push down on cap and twist to open.

Caution: Do not take with alcohol and no more than one. Do not operate heavy machinery or drive after taking New Day Pills.

I turned the bottle around, searching for more information. There wasn't even any ingredients or side effects included. I don't think this would get past the FDA like this. What was it, an energy pill? Start the day renewed? It wasn't for daily use, just before bed. I guess it's to have extra energy on waking up. My eyes began to feel a bit heavier. It was late, I was up all night and I have to work in the morning. God knows I'm going to feel like shit in the morning. I pushed down on the cap and twisted... nothing. I look at the directions again. Push down and twist. I did that. I look on the cap. "Push inward and twist". God this packaging is stupid, they can't even get the instructions right. I push inward and twisted and the cap made a distinct popping noise as I flicked the lid off. I peered into the bottle and spotted a few pills lurking inside. I tipped the bottle over and let one slide onto my open palm. I inspected the pill. Capsule, light blue and had the label "NPD" inscribed on it. I never heard of this pill and I don't even know who sent it to me. For all I knew, the pill could be laced with a type of poison or it would cause me to hallucinate. All the same, I didn't care. I popped the pill into my mouth and swallowed it with a handful of water from the sink tap. I was tired.

I lazily left my bathroom and stumbled towards my bed. My eyes felt heavier and heavier with each step. Was it the pill or the ass kicking I took earlier? My body started to feel like noodles and each step took more strength from me. I staggered down the hallway and I knew I wasn't going to reach the bed. I fell at the doorway to my room and I closed my eyes. I was drowsey and I wanted to sleep, so I did.

I woke up on my bed. I blinked my eyes and let them adjust to the morning light. I still felt tired. I guess the pills didn't really work at all. I turned in my bed and looked at the clock. I woke up minutes before the alarm was to go off. I wasn't going to get up before the alarm so I waited. Just a few more minutes. 3...2...1... and then I smacked the alarm clock the second it went off. I still didn't want to get up, but I spent too much time lounging around. I needed to get ready. I walked down the hall to the bathroom. I yawned as I entered the tiled room. I felt as if I didn't get any sleep and then I saw it. My face. I peered closer in the mirror. No, it couldn't be. I opened my mouth and searched for my missing tooth and miraculously it was still there. Cavities and all. It was like nothing happened. I searched for any sign of yesterday's unfortunate encounter and I couldn't find a single mark or bruise. The gash on my cheek was absent and my eye had not even a sign of swelling, though they looked tired. I was okay. Was it the pill?

I opened the cabinet and searched for the mysterious bottle that came in yesterday. It wasn't there. Where did it go? I took it out and... did I put it back in the cabinet again? No... I didn't. Maybe I dropped it. I looked on the floor and searched for pill bottle. Not a trace. I looked down the hallway. Maybe I dropped it going to bed. I searched the hallway and my room. I don't think I'd be able to find it in all this mess. I looked at the clock. I need to get ready for work. I put the pill search on hold and got myself ready for work. The bottle still floated in my mind as I did. I hurried out the door and as I walked down the driveway to get the daily newspaper, I saw the mail man. He approached me with a package and a few envelopes in hand. I took the mail and went back inside. I put the envelopes aside and looked at the small box. This one again. Did I get another one? I hurried to the kitchen and cut the tape apart and opened the box. A single pill bottle. New Day Pills. Start the day renewed!

I checked the label again. Same as the other one; devoid of any specific details. I pushed down on the cap and twisted. Same. It did not open. I pushed inwards and twisted and the cap came off. Same again. Wrong instructions. I looked in the bottle and saw the same light blue pills as before. I poured the pills out on the newspaper and took one in my hands. The same labeling as well. I put it down on the paper again and then I saw the date. November 12th. I double checked and I was sure it said November 12th. I thought it was a typo, but then I looked at the headline and head began to spin. Maybe they gave me the same paper as yesterday. They don't pay the kids as well as they used to, so I guess they slipped up. I couldn't dwell on it, I needed to get to work. I put the pills back into the bottle and left it on the counter.

I spent the day at work. I pushed the bottle and newspaper to the back of my mind, but it was hard. The entire day consisted of deja-vu and conversations I already had. My coworkers looked at me strangely when I accidentally finished some of their sentences. The papers that arrived at my desk, I knew all of them. I processed them already, but my boss told me they just came in. I looked hard at all the pages I went through. I strained myself looking for a single digit or letter different from what I remembered, but each one was a repeat of yesterday's work. They were playing a joke on me. A joke that everyone was in on, but even that was dismissed as the day went on and everyone kept a straight face. No one was joking. The hours ticked by, longer now that I've already experienced every conversation I was to have today. My mind was spinning. I needed to go home. The hours ticked down until my shift was over. I clocked out and took my coat and left. A few of my collegues tried to strike up a conversation, but I shrugged them off as I hurried to the car park. This day was like yesterday. Exactly like yesterday. I went down to where I parked my car. Every conversation and every joke. I reached for my keys. The paperwork. I fumbled with my keys for a second. Even the weather. I placed the key in the lock. Everything was a repeat... I heard foosteps. Oh fuck.

I got pulled back by a pair of hands and I fall on the floor. I tried to get on my feet, but then I got kicked in the stomach and I lost my breath. I receive a few more kicks before I gained my breath again. I feel the attacker's knee press against my back and his hands going through my pockets. I struggle a bit, but then I feel the knee get off my back. I try to turn around and then my face is met with a heavy blow. It stung. I try to get my head together, but by then, the attacker has already ran away. I got mugged again. I search my pockets. My wallet is gone and so is my phone. I look around. My keys are on the ground beside me and I think I see my wallet by the wheels of my car. I pick it up and look in the empty pockets. Fuck. It happened again. Exactly the same. I should have seen this coming. I should have been prepared. I pick up my keys and do a quick search of the parking lot. No one around. "FUCK FUCK FUCK FUCK" I shout kicking the cement pillar repeatedly. Flecks of blood sputter out of my mouth and stain the wall. "AGAIN! IT HAPPENED AGAIN! Aghhhh!" I keep shouting, still venting my frustration on the wall. "Again..." I say quietly to myself. The same guy, in the same way, taking the same things. I rush over to the car mirror and inspect the damage to my face. The gash, the swollen eye and the missing tooth. It's happened gain, in the same way. Today has happened again.

I rushed into my house. I didn't even bother filing a police report, I just went home. My jaw was throbbing and I could feel the blood pooling in my mouth, but I drove. I screeched into my driveway and jog to my door. I unlock it and fling it open. I didn't even bother closing the door as I made my way into the kitchen and to the counter. Still there. The bottle was still there with today's newspaper. I look at the bottle. New Day Pills – Start the day renewed! I open the bottle open and pull out a single pill. I look at it briefly before swallowing it dry. I can feel the pill already working its magic on me. My eyes feel heavy and my body weak.
